title: Post-Processor Coverage Audit — Brand × Machine-Class Gap Matrix
brief: Heuristic gap-audit that scans engines/ for *MasterPost*Engine.ts + *Post*Engine.ts and cross-references against a canonical 12-brand × 7-machine-class matrix. Closes the user's 'add post processor full coverage' directive with a measurable starting point. Compounds across the fleet — every chat that runs this sees the matrix and the gaps.

close_out_log.note: scripts/audit-post-processor-coverage.mjs — pure Node script that walks mcp-server/src/engines/ for *MasterPost*Engine.ts + Post*Engine.ts files (72 found this run), classifies each by brand (12 canonical: Hurco/Haas/Mazak/DMG Mori/Brother/Okuma/Fanuc/Siemens/Mitsubishi/Sodick/Agie/Makino) + machine class (7 canonical: mill 3-axis/mill 5-axis/lathe/mill-turn/swiss/wedm-wire/wedm-sinker), and emits a 12×7=84 cell matrix to state/shared/post-processor-coverage.{json,md}. First run: 64/84 cells covered, 20 gaps — ALL on wedm-sinker. R1: brand-regex is loose, will count co-occurrence as coverage (Hurco engine that mentions 'mill' anywhere is counted as Hurco-mill); real coverage is lower than 76% but the wedm-sinker universal gap is robust because the wedm-sinker regex is narrow.

units.title: scripts/audit-post-processor-coverage.mjs + matrix output
exit_conditions: Walks mcp-server/src/engines/ bounded scan (no recursion explosion)
Classifies each engine by brand (regex on class name + JSDoc head) + machine class (regex)
Emits 12×7 matrix with per-cell engine list
Operator-readable .md output with ✓/❌ matrix + gap punch list
JSON output for downstream consumers (gap-fill milestones)
units.description: Single audit that reveals the post-processor coverage shape. First-run finding: wedm-sinker is a universal gap across all 12 canonical brands. Coverage % is optimistic (R1) because brand+machine co-occurrence in unrelated text counts as covered — real coverage is lower, but the gap class (wedm-sinker) is robust. Operator-actionable: next ship is a wedm-sinker master-post family.

acceptance: scripts/audit-post-processor-coverage.mjs runs to completion. state/shared/post-processor-coverage.{json,md} produced. First-run output: 72 engines scanned, 64/84 cells covered, 20 gaps (all wedm-sinker). Operator can read the matrix and pick the next-highest-ROI master post to ship.

risks.description: Brand+machine-class classification is REGEX-HEURISTIC on the engine filename + first 4KB of source. False positives where brand string appears incidentally (a Hurco engine that mentions 'Mazak' in a comparison comment will be tagged for both brands). Real coverage is LOWER than the reported 76% — but the gap class (wedm-sinker) is robust because that regex is narrow. Mitigation: MS1 would parse JSDoc @brand / @machine annotations explicitly + reject co-occurrence without explicit declaration.

Canonical 12-brand × 7-machine-class matrix is hand-curated for small-shop America. Misses some real cells (Tornos Swiss, Star Swiss, Citizen Swiss are merged into 'swiss'; Index/Schütte have no row). MS1 would expand to 20+ brands + 10+ machine classes once the heuristic tightens.

The audit identifies engine PRESENCE, not quality. An engine matching the brand+class regex may still be a stub (Math.random) or pre-PROVE-OUT pattern. MS1 would cross-reference test count + dispatcher wiring + prove-out support per engine to grade each cell as production-ready vs research-only.
